caption: The drawing depicts a lidded goblet or chalice rendered in grayscale pencil on a vertically oriented, light-colored paper. The main object is a symmetrical, pedestal-based vessel with a wide, shallowly domed lid that has a small finial at the top, a tall, tapered cup with a slight lip near the rim, and a rounded, multi-tiered stem with a broad, circular base. The goblet is centrally positioned within a large rectangular border. On the lower left, there is a smaller rectangular inset showing a top-down or plan view of the base with concentric circles and two labeled measurements. On the lower right, another small rectangle contains a scaled-down outline of the full vessel with vertical and horizontal measurements noted. The drawing includes precise, clean lines and some areas of soft shading to indicate form and dimension, but no color beyond the varying tones of graphite pencil.
title: Pewter Chalice
